errors.text_span: Всяка категория е представена от стълб
errors.evidence: The chart is a grouped bar chart where each main category (scenario) on the x-axis is represented by a group of three stacked bars, corresponding to the years 2030, 2040, and 2050. The description incorrectly states that each category is represented by a single bar.
The vertical axis has major gridlines and labels at intervals of 20 (0, 20, 40, 60, 80, 100, 120), not 10.
The legend in the chart labels this category as „Въглища (ТЕЦ)”, not „Въглища (TEL)”.

errors.text_span: като в някои случаи определени сегменти са визуално подчертани чрез различни цветове
errors.evidence: The different colors are not used for highlighting specific segments. They are used to encode the different categories of energy sources, as defined in the legend. This statement shows a fundamental misunderstanding of how colored stacked bar charts work.

The description of the horizontal axis omits the crucial information that each of the five main scenarios is subdivided by year (2030, 2040, and 2050), which corresponds to the three bars in each group.
